description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named LocationActivity which demonstrates how to use Android's location services, including requesting location updates from GPS and network providers, handling location changes, reverse geocoding to obtain human-readable addresses, and prompting the user to enable GPS if disabled.

classes.name: LocationActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing location updates, UI components, and user interaction for location-based features.

classes.name: EnableGpsDialogFragment
classes.description: Inner class that displays a dialog prompting the user to enable GPS services.

classes.name: ReverseGeocodingTask
classes.description: Inner AsyncTask class that performs reverse geocoding in the background to convert coordinates into a human-readable address.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, restores state, sets up UI components, and prepares location manager.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves UI state variables for activity restoration after rotation.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets up location providers when activity resumes.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks if GPS is enabled; prompts user to enable it if disabled.

methods.name: enableLocationSettings
methods.description: Launches intent to open location settings for user to enable GPS.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes location updates when activity stops.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures location request parameters based on user preferences for GPS and network providers.

methods.name: requestUpdatesFromProvider
methods.description: Requests location updates from specified provider, handling unavailability.

methods.name: useFineProvider
methods.description: Sets activity to use only GPS provider and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: useCoarseFineProviders
methods.description: Configures activity to use both GPS and network providers for location updates.

methods.name: doReverseGeocoding
methods.description: Starts async task to convert geographic location into an address.

methods.name: updateUILocation
methods.description: Updates UI with current location data and initiates reverse geocoding if available.

methods.name: getBetterLocation
methods.description: Evaluates two Location objects and returns the more accurate and timely one.

methods.name: isSameProvider
methods.description: Checks if two location providers are the same.
